services.desc: Hidden deep within an ancient jungle, the entrance to a forgotten temple lies buried with centuries of secrets. The legend of the Serpent Sanctum has been whispered across generations, but none who have ventured inside have ever returned. Once said to be a sacred site for the worship of the feathered serpent god, its dwellers performed mystical rituals to unlock the universe’s deepest mysteries. Down a nondescript corridor, past the old library and beyond the general store, you will find Madam Zita’s curiosites - a burial ground for her collection of wicked artifacts that time has long but forgotten.
